note: v1 92.46 (seeds 0/11 92.46/92.33), first draft of EUPHORIC ANTHEM, 'Ring Road Sunrise': piano-led liquid D&B, the night's last tune as the sky goes pale. A concert grand plays house-piano stabs on Dmaj9 - E6 - C#m7 - F#m9 in the drops and holds each chord, rolled, outside them; a soaring wordless voice line into a long hall, strings doubling it in the second drop; a straight amen roll with a crash on every phrase, a sub and a low reese pumped by it. The break ends on wM's endless Shepard rise under a snare roll - a climb that never seems to arrive until the last drop lands.
